notes:
Short summary: Axiom Call Brief is a contact-center SaaS vendor building a post-call briefing product for mid-large enterprise buyers. Primary ask: reliable automated post-call summaries + QA scoring + coaching highlights extracted per call, integrated into Zendesk/Salesforce. 

Pain points / requirements (shorthand):
- Must handle spikes: expected P0 scenario = 8k concurrent live calls during peak campaigns; batch post-call jobs overnight for 100k calls/day.
- Latency: real-time agent assist streaming for live calls (token streaming -> agent HUD) with target RTT < 400ms for suggestion snippets; post-call summary can be async (<= 30s).
- Quality: extract top-3 coaching highlights, verbatim 'issue' lines for ticket creation. Accuracy thresholds: summary precision > 0.78 (eval metric), QA-scoring correlation with human raters > 0.7.
- Models: prefer open/model weights for on-prem; willing to accept Redwood-hosted for POC. Interested in quantized 8-bit LLM variants + fallback to larger model for complex dialogs.
- Security: SSO/SAML, per-tenant KMS for key management, audit logging, and EU data residency for certain customers.
- Integrations: Zendesk/SFDC connectors, ability to trigger workflow/actions (create ticket, escalate, flag for QA).

Quotes / call snippets: "We need coaching highlights that actually save supervisors time — not a paragraph of fluff." — VP Product. "If you can't show redaction/KMS in POC we can't move forward." — Head of Security.

POC plan (agreed): 2-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated pool. Deliverables: ingest 1k recorded calls (their sample), run transcription -> generate 1k post-call summaries and QA scores, provide dashboard of latency/cost per 1k calls, show KMS-backed key rotation demo. Acceptance criteria: sample summaries meet human eval threshold and platform sustains burst to 10k concurrent inference requests (with graceful degradation).

Next steps (actionable): SE (Devon) to send POC runbook and infra sizing by 2026-03-15. Outline Dedicated pool config + fallback routing. Legal to receive SOC2 addendum by 2026-03-18. Sales to capture PO/commit if POC passes by 2026-04.

Internal notes: watch for overlap with Observe.AI relationship; Axiom currently evaluating both. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity if unit economics are clear.
